citeAs: Chen, Chongyan, Mengchen Liu, Noel Codella, Yunsheng Li, Lu Yuan, and Danna Gurari (2024). Fully Authentic Visual Question Answering Dataset from Online Communities.
creator: Chongyan Chen, Mengchen Liu, Noel Codella, Yunsheng Li, Lu Yuan, Danna Gurari (University of Texas at Austin; Microsoft; University of Colorado Boulder)
description: VQAonline is a visual question answering dataset sourced from Stack Exchange online question answering communities. Each example includes a natural language question, context, image, and an accepted answer validated by the person who asked the question, spanning 105 topics and 64,696 VQAs.
name: VQAonline
publisher: University of Texas at Austin; Microsoft; University of Colorado Boulder
rai:annotationsPerItem: 2 or 3 for the user intention annotation subset; 3 crowdworker labels were used per visual question when the first two workers disagreed.
rai:annotatorDemographics: For user intention annotation, the paper used three Amazon Mechanical Turk crowdworkers located in the United States who had completed more than 500 HITs with over a 95% approval rating. For human evaluation of model outputs, ten annotators were domain experts in one of ten topics, each with at least a Master’s degree in a related field, and located in the United States.
rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: For the user intention taxonomy development, two author-annotators iteratively labeled examples over four rounds, with agreement accuracy improving from 53.3% to 87.5% and Cohen’s kappa improving from 45.24% to 84.69%. For the crowdsourced user intention annotations, two independent workers labeled each of 105 randomly selected VQAs and a third worker broke ties for the 25 disagreements.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: For user intention annotations, workers were given instructions, taxonomy definitions, and two examples per category. They labeled one primary intent per visual question after viewing the question, context, and answer; two independent annotations were collected per selected VQA, and a third worker resolved disagreements.
rai:dataBiases: The paper explicitly notes representation bias: the dataset may poorly represent people in poverty-stricken areas because Stack Exchange users need access to mobile devices and the Internet, and Stack Exchange geographic representation is unbalanced, with more from the US, India, and Europe and less from countries like Egypt.
rai:dataCollection: The dataset was created by scraping publicly available data from the Stack Exchange online question-answering platform. The authors collected examples containing a natural language question, natural language context, an image, and at least one answer, and kept only examples with an accepted answer.
rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Examples for which the image could not be downloaded from the provided link were removed from the dataset.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: Raw data came from the Stack Exchange archive in XML format and originally included posts with titles, body text, image URL links, and publicly provided answers from users.
rai:dataLimitations: The paper notes that VQAonline has atypically long answers that are incompatible with standard VQA evaluation metrics. It also notes the dataset may poorly represent people in poverty-stricken areas because Stack Exchange users need mobile devices and Internet access, and that geographic representation is unbalanced, with more users from the US, India, and Europe and less from countries like Egypt.
rai:dataManipulationProtocol: The dataset was split into training, validation, and test sets by randomly selecting 7 examples per eligible topic for training and 3 for validation from topics with at least 20 examples, leaving the remainder for test.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The authors filtered the scraped Stack Exchange data to keep examples with a question, context, image, and at least one answer, then retained only examples with an accepted answer. They removed visual questions with scores of 0 or less for either the question or answer, excluded questions with multiple images or visual answers, removed examples whose images could not be downloaded, and converted all images to PNG format for consistency.
rai:dataSocialImpact: The paper says the dataset can encourage community-wide progress on authentic visual question answering and that improved models could benefit community question answering platforms, learning assistance tools for children, virtual assistants, visual dialog and query, and visual search and browsing. It also discusses societal concerns about underrepresentation of people in poverty-stricken areas and geographic imbalance.
rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is intended for benchmarking and improving visual question answering models on authentic use cases. The paper also says improved models for VQAonline could benefit other community question answering platforms, learning assistance VQA tools for children, virtual assistants, visual dialog and query, and visual search and browsing.
rai:machineAnnotationTools: GPT-3.5 was used to help bootstrap initial free-form user intention categories via zero-shot prompting, and DeepSolo was used to detect text presence in images across the dataset.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The paper states the dataset includes multilingual VQAs and questions posted by Stack Exchange users from various countries; it also discusses geographic representation across countries. No direct collection of personal identifiers is described.

null_reasons.rai:dataImputationProtocol: paper describes filtering/removal of unavailable examples but no imputation or fill-in strategy
null_reasons.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: no versioning, update cadence, or maintenance plan described
